# War Scroll Column 7 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 7 | **Condition:** complete

---

**7:1** No boy or woman shall enter their camps when they go forth from Jerusalem to battle, until they return.

**7:2** No one who is lame, blind, or crippled, nor any man who has a permanent blemish in his flesh, nor any man afflicted with an impurity of the flesh —

**7:3** none of these shall go forth with them to battle. All of them shall be volunteers for war, perfect in spirit and body, and prepared for the Day of Vengeance.

**7:4** Any man who is not ritually pure with respect to a seminal emission on the day of battle shall not go down with them into battle, for the holy angels are among their congregations.

**7:5** There shall be a distance between all their camps and the latrine of about two thousand cubits, and no indecent nakedness shall be seen in the surroundings of any of their camps.

**7:6** When they set out for battle, they shall arrange themselves in their encampments, and each man shall take his position in his place, and they shall keep watch with their weapons in their hands.

**7:7** Armed escorts shall go out for the needs of the camp and shall stand guard continually over all the arrangements of the camp, so that they do not profane the holy precincts of their encampments.

**7:8** Sentries shall stand at their posts around the camps, and watchmen shall keep the watches of the night, and they shall not put down their weapons.

**7:9** Any man who needs to go outside for a bodily need shall go with his weapons, and the armed escort shall accompany him until he returns to the camp.

**7:10** When the battle lines are drawn up, there shall be three rows of horsemen on one side and three rows on the other.

**7:11** Between the rows there shall be a distance of one hundred cubits, and between rank and rank fifty cubits, and they shall stand in order before the battle formation.

**7:12** Each row shall have one hundred horsemen, and they shall be arranged on the flanks of the formation: seven hundred on one side and seven hundred on the other.

**7:13** They shall spread outward to the right and to the left of the battle line, to frighten the enemies of God and to cut off those who flee.

**7:14** The men of the battle line shall be from forty to fifty years of age, and the camp marshals shall be from fifty to sixty years.

**7:15** The horsemen shall be from thirty to forty-five years, and those who strip the slain, collect the plunder, and cleanse the land

**7:16** shall be from twenty-five to thirty years. No youth shall go out with them on the day of battle.

**7:17** All of these shall be volunteers for the war of God, men of understanding and strength, and they shall serve according to the ordering of their divisions.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus closely follows LOGOS. Key decisions: (1) "latrine" preferred over EMET's "place-of-the-hand" for clarity while noting the euphemism; (2) "holy angels are among their congregations" preserved per LOGOS over PNEUMA's "march in the ranks alongside the soldiers"; (3) "Day of Vengeance" capitalized as eschatological title; (4) "volunteers for war" preserved over PNEUMA's "willing volunteers" — the Hebrew mitnaddvim already implies willingness.*
